div.div: كَلِيتٌ and ↓ كِلِّيتٌ An oblong stone (resembling a بِرْطِيل, TA) with which the hole of a hyena is stopped up: (K:) so (يُسَدُّ بِهِ) accord. to IDrd.: or, as in some copies يُسْبَرُ به, is probed: or, as in the TS, يُسْتَرُ به, is covered: after this is applied, the earth is dug away to find the hyena: mentioned by IAar. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
